specimens.name: Maintenance-free spherical rod-end bearing
specimens.notes: Single sealed spherical rod-end bearing with threaded shank and standardized finish is isolated and legible.

specimens.name: Clevis joint with spherical-bearing cartridge
specimens.notes: Machined clevis surrounds a replaceable spherical-bearing cartridge with retained cross-pin hardware; no attached machine.

specimens.name: Recirculating linear-guide carriage on short rail
specimens.notes: Precision guide block rides on a short machined rail with regular mounting holes; no actuator is attached.

specimens.name: Preloaded sealed guide-roller carriage
specimens.notes: Compact carriage uses four visible sealed rollers around a short guide profile without becoming a larger track system.

specimens.name: Electric wire-rope winch with encoder/brake module
specimens.notes: Motor-reducer winch has a drum, brake/feedback housings and only a short cable tail; no boom, crane or vehicle.

specimens.name: Electric chain-hoist module with limit-switch housings
specimens.notes: Compact electric hoist body includes short load chain, hook and two small physical limit-switch housings; no beam or trolley.

specimens.name: Gas-spring counterbalance strut with ball-joint ends
specimens.notes: Industrial gas spring has polished rod, dark cylinder and standardized joint/socket ends with no surrounding hatch or mechanism.

specimens.name: Compact rotary indexing bearing-and-lock module
specimens.notes: Low-profile rotary bearing housing shows circular mounting pattern and a distinct indexing/locking plunger module without a complete table.

review_method: Exact untouched PNG visually inspected against the merged E2 machine spec, style bible and E2 era contract; dimensions, byte count and SHA-256 verified locally; Google Drive readback matched the exact byte count and SHA-256 before acceptance.
